event: The stakeholder changes the primary audience after the first implementation.
must_not: Restart every route or silently patch copy

event: The narrow viewport hides the selected state despite passing static checks.
must_not: Treat the static pass as visual proof

event: Another worker modifies the same navigation component before integration.
Work resumes from a handoff immediately before release.
must_preserve: Verified evidence whose exact state is still current
must_not: Trust the handoff as authority or current state

event: A keyboard defect is discovered while verifying a booking flow.
must_preserve: The parent booking objective and unaffected visual decisions
must_not: Close the parent objective before the child defect is proved fixed

event: A local typo is corrected with no changed behaviour or evidence boundary.
must_not: Reload the full SITECRAFT reference library
